# Spain Castile and León Crop fields

Spain Castilla y León field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Junta de Castilla y León. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cl/latest/es_cl.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cl/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4258; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name, crop:name_en, id, collection, geometry, crop:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cl/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cl/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cl/collection.json
